chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: 'Not one of you should swallow what he picks teeth with, for pus can happen from it'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on swallowing debris removed from between the teeth?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises against swallowing the debris cleared from between the teeth, warning that it may cause *dubaylah* (pus or abscess). This instruction reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of linking daily hygiene practices to internal health, emphasizing that neglecting minor physical cleanliness can have tangible physiological consequences.
